description: Policy shared by every hub (renovate-config's default.json, go-tools' go-renovaterc): the timezone the schedule presets are evaluated in, the 7-day third-party release-age soak, the monthly window, vulnerability alerts, and hugoh/hk-config//renovate.json (how to read the hk pins; presets/hk-toolchain says how they group). Hubs keep their ecosystem rules and groups on top of this.
